text: I stay OPPOSE. HOG is LEADER with a strong sector, but ABOVE_STRUCTURE with coil warn gives no sound base or pivot (R3), and day_vol 1.39 is just short of the R4 1.40 bar. reclaim:ma_20 buys a pullback to an average, not a pivot. My would_clear is narrow and I keep it: whichever trigger the room ratifies must print on volume at least 1.4x normal for the time of day (C16). I can accept reclaim:ma_20 or h1_close_above:bar_high as the word if that volume clause is on it; without it I object. What would move my stance: a countable base and a new high on 1.4x volume.
